answer: Hardware-root-of-trust enclave attestation resists sybils: each agent must present a remote-attestation quote signed by a genuine TEE whose manufacturer endorsement key is fused one-per-chip, like pigment baked into the silicon that cannot be repainted or copied. Spinning up ten identities then means buying ten real CPUs, so forks that once flowed as free nectar become a hard per-seat capital cost, and one revoked chip carries a raven-black revocation mark that poisons its whole attested batch.
